## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Relevant focused regression tests
- [ ] `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run`

## Compatibility and privacy

- [ ] Existing MCP tool names remain compatible, or the breaking change is explicit.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic and contain no private paths, code, credentials, or host names.
- [ ] Accuracy and performance claims include their measurement boundary.

## Limitations

List known limitations or write “None”.
